I cannot generate the SOAP note because the actual transcript and DDx have not been provided. The message contains placeholders {transcript} and {ddx}. Please supply the patient transcript text and the DDx JSON, then I will produce the structured note per your instructions.

In the meantime, here is a ready-to-fill template you can paste the actual data into:

Subjective:
- Current issues, reasons for visit, and history of presenting complaints:
  - Presenting complaint: [from transcript]
  - Onset: [from transcript]
  - Duration: [from transcript]
  - Progression or course: [from transcript]
  - Associated symptoms: [from transcript]
- Past medical history: [from transcript]
- Previous surgeries: [from transcript]
- Medications: [from transcript] (if medication listed without dose/route/frequency, note: “dose/route/frequency not documented.”)
- Social history: [from transcript]
- Allergies: [from transcript]
- Other relevant information: [from transcript]

Objective:
- Vital signs: [if provided in transcript; list values and date/time]
- Physical examination findings:
  - General appearance: [from transcript]
  - System-specific findings (e.g., HEENT, cardiovascular, respiratory, abdominal, neurologic, musculoskeletal, skin): [from transcript]
  - Laterality/details (e.g., left/right, affected/unaffected): [from transcript]
- Investigations: [results noted in transcript or planned tests and results if provided]

Assessment & Plan:

1. Issue, Problem, or Request 1 (name of the condition):
   - Assessment: [likely diagnosis or working impression based on transcript]
   - Differential diagnoses (from DDx only if consistent with transcript; mark if conflict noted):
     - [DDx item 1] [likelihood tag if available]
     - [DDx item 2] [likelihood tag if available]
     - [Additional consistent differentials from DDx as applicable]
   - Investigations planned: [tests or imaging planned or ordered; include rationale if stated]
   - Treatment planned: [medications, therapies, non-pharmacologic measures; include route/dose if provided or note “dose/route/frequency not documented”]
   - Referrals: [specialist or ancillary services if indicated]

2. Issue, Problem, or Request 2 (name of the condition):
   - Assessment: [as above]
   - Differential diagnoses (consistent with transcript and DDx):
   - Investigations planned:
   - Treatments planned:
   - Referrals:

3. Issue, Problem, or Request 3 (name of the condition):
   - Assessment: 
   - Differential diagnoses (consistent with transcript and DDx):
   - Investigations planned:
   - Treatments planned:
   - Referrals:

Quality checks (place at bottom or in documentQuality section):
- Missing but clinically expected elements for a consult (e.g., allergies, meds reconciliation): [Yes/No; details]
- Internal conflicts between transcript and DDx: [None / conflict noted → specify items]
- Brief comment on transcript quality (e.g., noisy/inaudible sections): [None / provide specifics]

Please provide:
- The full transcript text
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON or a readable list

Then I will generate the complete SOAP note with accurate, concise, professional content, following the exact structure you requested.
